$comment: Read by an external, project-agnostic tier runner -- not owned by this repo. One tier: light runs the tests of the local frontmatter plugin in plugins/note-properties (with its dev dependencies, before the plugin install prunes them), then mirrors the deploy workflow (npm ci, plugin install, Quartz's own tests under quartz/ (the plugin's vitest files would break a bare tsx --test), a full quartz build), which is the only check that catches a broken page, a bad wikilink target or a malformed frontmatter block before it reaches the published site. No services, no browser. The full (non-slim) node image is required: the quartz CLI shells out to git at import time and crashes when the binary is missing.

light.run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && (cd plugins/note-properties && rm -rf dist && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm run typecheck && npm test) && rm -rf .quartz quartz.lock.json && npx quartz plugin install --from-config && npx tsx --test "quartz/**/*.test.ts" "quartz/**/*.test.js" && npx quartz build
